entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6423"/><div sID="gen9835" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6423"/>6-7. (Compare <reference osisRef="Jer.10.25">Jr 10:25</reference>). Though we deserve much, do not the heathen deserve more for their violence to us (<reference osisRef="Jer.51.3-Jer.51.5">Jr 51:3-5</reference>; <reference osisRef="Zech.1.14">Zec 1:14</reference>)? The singular denotes the chief power, and the use of the plural indicates the combined confederates.<div eID="gen9835" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen9836" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">called upon--</hi>or, "by"<div eID="gen9836" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen9837" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">thy name--</hi>proclaimed Thy attributes and professed allegiance (<reference osisRef="Isa.12.4">Is 12:4</reference>; <reference osisRef="Acts.2.21">Ac 2:21</reference>). <div eID="gen9837" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 6-7. (Compare Jr 10:25 ). Though we deserve much, do not the heathen deserve more for their violence to us ( Jr 51:3-5 ; Zec 1:14 )? The singular denotes the chief power, and the use of the plural indicates the combined confederates. called upon-- or, "by" thy name-- proclaimed Thy attributes and professed allegiance ( Is 12:4 ; Ac 2:21 ).
entries.reader_content_plain: 6-7. (Compare Jr 10:25 ). Though we deserve much, do not the heathen deserve more for their violence to us ( Jr 51:3-5 ; Zec 1:14 )?
